{{Quote|Present your boarding card.''"<br />"''Certainly, trooper. I'm sure you'll find ''everything is in order.''|The clone trooper, and Kai Hudorra|<ref name="Republic 80" />}}
A '''clone stormtrooper''' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] early in its reign under [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Keller (clone commander)|Keller]] and his [[Keller's unit|unit]]. The [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] was present on [[Toola/Legends|Toola]] following the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], and was part of a group stationed at the [[Toola Spaceport]]. Two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] survivors, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kai Hudorra]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Noirah Na]] were able to trick the trooper into letting them board a [[Transport/Legends|transport]].

==Biography==
===Early life and Clone Wars===
[[Reproduction/Legends|Grown]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from the [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] of the [[Clone template/Legends|prime clone]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], the basis of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Army/Legends|army]],<ref name="Clone Troopers" /> the trooper served in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[Toola/Legends|Toola]] soon after the implementation of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]],<ref name="Republic 80" /> a directive by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]&ndash; publicly the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]&ndash; that called for the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|extermination]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> in the final [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] forces had previously participated in the [[Battle of Toola]], an engagement between Republic forces led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Kai Hudorra]] and [[Simms]], alongside [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Noirah Na]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Keller]].<ref name="Republic 79">[[Republic 79|''Republic'' 79]]</ref>

===Providing Imperial security===
{{Quote|Everything is in order. Proceed.|The clone, to the two Jedi fugitives|<ref name="Republic 80" />}}
With Order 66 declared shortly after the Republic victory, Hudorra and Na were able to survive the assault and escape to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ithaqua Station]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Keller led his [[Keller's unit|clone detachment]]<ref name="Republic 79" /> of the [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines]]<ref name="SW30C">''[[Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection]]''</ref> in hunting down the surviving Jedi.<ref name="Republic 79" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Hudorra and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] Na then traveled to the [[Toola Spaceport]] in the city to escape to the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. There they encountered a clone contingent, including the [[clone stormtrooper|trooper]], who had a responsibility to check the boarding cards of civilians.<ref name="Republic 80" />

The trooper ordered the pair to present boarding passes, during which Hudorra displayed his card and used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to convince the trooper that everything was in order. The trooper confirmed as such, and the two Jedi were allowed to board a [[Transport/Legends|transport]].<ref name="Republic 80" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of Jango Fett,<ref name="Republic 80" /> the trooper was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="SWE" /> The trooper succumbed to a Jedi mind trick,<ref name="Republic 80" /> which was usually effective against the weak-minded.<ref name="Essential Guide to the Force">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

==Equipment==
The trooper was outfitted with white [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|phase II clone trooper armor]], a white [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldon]], and a white [[Kama/Legends|kama]]. While at the Toola Spaceport, the trooper utilized a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="Republic 80" />

==Behind the scenes==
The trooper debuted in [[Republic 80|''Republic'' 80]], the second of a two-part story arc within ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' by [[Dark Horse Comics]].<ref name="Republic 80" /> The comic was released on [[December 21]], [[2005]],<ref name="DHC">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/10-448/Star-Wars-Republic-80|text=Star Wars: Republic #80}}</ref> and was authored by [[Randy Stradley]] and pencilled by [[Douglas Wheatley]].<ref name="Republic 80" />
